                    WHERE name = %s
                """, (match[0].parent,), as_dict=True)
        else:
            # 3) البحث عن جهة اتصال فرعية مطابقة للرقم داخل نفس الوكالة
            contact_match = frappe.db.sql("""
                SELECT contact_name, pcc
                FROM `tabSabre Agency Contact`
                WHERE (phone LIKE %s OR mobile LIKE %s) AND parent = %s
                LIMIT 1
            """, ('%' + tail, '%' + tail, agency_row[0].name), as_dict=True)

            if contact_match:
                contact_name = contact_match[0].contact_name or ''
                contact_pcc = contact_match[0].pcc or ''

                contact_name = agency_row[0].primary_contact_name or ''

        # 4) التحديث الآمن: حماية القيم الموجودة مسبقاً من الإلغاء

            # احتفظ بالاسم القادم من البوب اب إن وجد، وإلا استخدم الاسم المستخرج
            final_contact_name = doc.get('custom_contact_name') or contact_name

            vals = {

                'custom_agency_iata': row.iata or '',
                'custom_agency_pcc': contact_pcc or row.pcc or '',
                'custom_agency_email': row.email or '',
                'custom_agency_phone': row.phone or '',
            }
            
            for k, v in vals.items():
                doc.db_set(k, v, update_modified=False)

name: Git Name of Customer From Sabre Agency To Call log
script:
def find_sabre_agency(phone_val):
    if not phone_val:
        return None
    
    # استخراج الأرقام فقط وتجاهل الأسماء والتحويلات
    digits = "".join([c for c in str(phone_val) if c.isdigit()])
    if len(digits) < 6:
        return None
        
    # البحث بآخر 8 أرقام للتطابق بغض النظر عن البادئة (70 / 010 / +20)
    search_param = f"%{digits[-8:]}%" if len(digits) >= 8 else f"%{digits}%"

    # 1. البحث في جدول الوكالات الرئيسي (Sabre Agency)
    agency = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT name FROM `tabSabre Agency`
        WHERE phone LIKE %s
        LIMIT 1
    """, (search_param,), as_dict=True)

    if agency:
        return agency[0].name

    # 2. البحث في جدول جهات الاتصال الفرعي (Sabre Agency Contact)
    contact = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT parent FROM `tabSabre Agency Contact`
        WHERE phone LIKE %s OR mobile LIKE %s
        LIMIT 1
    """, (search_param, search_param), as_dict=True)

    if contact:
        return contact[0].parent

    return None

# فحص رقم المتصل ورقم المستلم من حقول Call Log المباشرة
from_field = doc.get("from")
to_field = doc.get("to")

agency_id = find_sabre_agency(from_field) or find_sabre_agency(to_field)

if agency_id:
    doc.custom_agency = agency_id

# ============================================================
# Server Script: Auto Link Ticket to Call Log
# DocType: HD Ticket | Event: After Insert
# ============================================================
if not doc.get("custom_call_log"):
    phone = doc.get("custom_phone_number") or doc.get("custom_agency_phone")
    if phone:
        digits = "".join([ch for ch in str(phone) if ch.isdigit()])
        if len(digits) >= 6:
            search_param = f"%{digits[-8:]}%" if len(digits) >= 8 else f"%{digits}%"
            
            # البحث فقط عن مكالمة أُنشئت في آخر 10 دقائق
            latest_call = frappe.db.sql("""
                SELECT name FROM `tabCall Log`
                WHERE (`from` LIKE %s OR `to` LIKE %s)
                  AND creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE
                ORDER BY creation DESC
                LIMIT 1
            """, (search_param, search_param), as_dict=True)

            if latest_call:
                call_log_id = latest_call[0].name
                doc.db_set("custom_call_log", call_log_id, update_modified=False)
                frappe.db.set_value("Call Log", call_log_id, "custom_ticket", doc.name)

script:
# ============================================================
# Server Script: Auto Link Call Log to Ticket
# DocType: Call Log | Event: After Insert
# ============================================================
phone_number = doc.get("from") or doc.get("to") or ""
digits = "".join([ch for ch in str(phone_number) if ch.isdigit()])

if len(digits) >= 6:
    search_param = f"%{digits[-8:]}%" if len(digits) >= 8 else f"%{digits}%"

    recent_ticket = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT name FROM `tabHD Ticket`
        WHERE (custom_phone_number LIKE %s OR custom_agency_phone LIKE %s)
          AND (custom_call_log IS NULL OR custom_call_log = '')
          AND creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
        ORDER BY creation DESC
        LIMIT 1
    """, (search_param, search_param), as_dict=True)

    if recent_ticket:
        ticket_name = recent_ticket[0].name
        doc.db_set("custom_ticket", ticket_name, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value("HD Ticket", ticket_name, "custom_call_log", doc.name)
